payload.title: Zurich The Circle — FY26 HUB LCR AV & MPR Refresh
payload.summary: FY26 HUB LCR audio-visual program at Microsoft Zurich – The Circle: Radon room 9.3E rollout, Dual MPR rooms 10.3D/10.3E AV refresh (rescheduled to Dec 2026–Feb 2027), procurement/PO approvals, and the WWT->Zones AV PM handover.

pmStatus.current: FY26 HUB LCR AV program at Zurich – The Circle is in execution. Radon 9.3E installed and in handover/commissioning; Dual MPR rooms 10.3D/10.3E AV refresh rescheduled to start 1 Dec 2026 with a freeze to ~12 Feb 2027; most procurement POs approved; AV project management transitions from WWT to Zones on 1 Jul 2026.

planned.text: Dual MPR 10.3D/10.3E refresh window 1 Dec 2026 – 12 Feb 2027
AV PM handover WWT -> Zones effective 1 Jul 2026

userActions.text: Confirm to local team that Dual MPR refresh can start 1 Dec 2026
Approve/reject pending SAP invoices for PO 101577907
Action PO extension 101608497 (keep open until December)

problems.text: Radon installation was blocked by screen-mount / wall-reinforcement issues

risks.text: Zones hardware delivery delays could jeopardize the MPR deployment timeline
Pre-delivered AV hardware storage costs CHF 3'578/month while deployment is deferred

waitingOn.text: Confirmed delivery dates from Zones for MPR hardware
